snippet.title: MapGod - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
MapGod — Launching August 5th on Steam!

A chaotic 3-16 player online multiplayer platformer. Fight to survive, outlast your rivals, and become the MapGod — turning the entire map against everyone else.

🎮 Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4922530/MapGod/

🔹 3-16 player online PvP
🔹 Pixel art visual style
🔹 Fast-paced party gameplay
🔹 The last one standing becomes the MapGod and controls the map
🔹 Launching August 5th, 2026

Follow us:
Discord: https://discord.gg/tguvtYjmHn
